Counsel for Petitioner :- Akhilesh Kumar Pandey,Shreesh Bahadur Tripathi Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
Heard Sri Akhilesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Sanjay Kumar Srivastava,
learned counsel who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant in the Office but his name is not shown as well as Sri Yogeshwar Rai, learned State Law Officer for the State respondents.
The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 01.12.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 279 of 2022, under Section 376,
354Kha, 323, 506, 313, 511 IPC, P.S. Holagarh, District Prayagraj, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.

Sri Yogeshwar Rai, learned State Law Officer, on instructions, states that in the present case, non bailable warrant has been issued against the petitioner no.1 which clearly reflects that he is not submitting himself for the purposes of investigation.

sentences.text: From perusal of the record, we find that the allegations leveled against the petitioner are of serious nature and a cognizable offence is made out.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1)
SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
